## Featured Applications & Open Source

### 1. ShareVault — Secure Sharing Platform
- **Live URL:** https://share-vault-mango.vercel.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/nikhil-nandanwar/ShareVault
- **Technologies:** React, Node.js, MongoDB, Cloudflare R2
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Ephemeral 6-digit code generation for zero-credential transfers.
  - Direct-to-storage signed upload links avoiding server memory bottlenecks.
  - Automatic expiration TTL indexes on MongoDB records.

### 2. GeminiChat — AI Chat Application
- **Live URL:** https://ai-by-gemini.netlify.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/nikhil-nandanwar/GeminiApp
- **Technologies:** React, Node.js, Google Gemini API
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Streamed chunk-by-chunk token rendering with auto-scroll handling.
  - Persistent thread storage with markdown and code syntax rendering.
  - Thread export and shareable conversation URLs.

### 3. Mines Game — Minesweeper Game
- **Live URL:** https://mines-game.netlify.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/nikhil-nandanwar/Mines
- **Technologies:** HTML5, CSS3, Modern JavaScript
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Optimized flood-fill reveal algorithm with recursive boundary checking.
  - Adjustable grid dimensions and custom mine density probabilities.
  - Zero layout shift timer and flag counter with high-contrast accessibility.
